# Usable for everyone

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Accessibility
- What: Make the app usable by everyone, including people who use a keyboard or a screen reader.
- Applies when: the app has screens.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: Every page works by keyboard alone, form fields have labels, and an automated accessibility scan reports no serious problems.

### Responsive design
- What: Make every screen work at every size, from phone to desktop.
- Applies when: the app is used on different screen sizes.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: Every screen is usable at phone width: nothing cut off, no sideways scrolling, buttons large enough to tap.

### Screen states
- What: Show something useful while data loads, when there is none, and when loading fails.
- Applies when: the app has screens that load data.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Scope: cross-cutting
- Proof: test
- Done when: Every screen that loads data shows a loading state, an empty state and an error state. Tests force each one.

### Localization
- What: Show the app in more than one language, including right-to-left ones where needed.
- Applies when: the app must work in more than one language.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: All visible text comes from translation files. Switching language changes every screen, including right-to-left layout where the language needs it.
